🚨 PRESS CORPS FLASH: President Donald Trump sparked intense backlash after launching a harsh personal attack against Reuters White House correspondent Jacob Bogage during a press gaggle at Joint Base Andrews. The confrontation erupted after Air Force One returned from a campaign stop in South Carolina. Bogage questioned Trump regarding his abrupt decision to cancel scheduled weekend in-person campaign rallies in Kansas and Iowa ahead of the high-stakes midterm elections, asking if the pullout had "anything to do with you being sick of traveling". Visibly drenched in sweat, the 80-year-old president bristled at the suggestion of travel fatigue. Trump fiercely shot back, "You are a sick guy. Reuters is terrible, by the way," before turning his attention to the journalist's physical condition, stating, "Look at this guy—he's way out of shape... You are disgusting. Put yourself in shape. You look like hell". Trump defended pulling out of the Kansas event by asserting that incumbent Republican Senator Roger Marshall was doing exceptionally well and did not require an in-person appearance, opting to conduct a virtual tele-rally instead before traveling to Florida.
